observation_reviews.rationale: Exact Kaseya row has rate 10.83 and S + 5.50 without PIK; two preceding Kaseya rows explicitly include 2.50% PIK. The Wellness typed member carries 2.50% PIK but its numeric facts have no PaidInKind rate. Published 2.5 therefore conflicts with the printed position cell. Source ambiguity is warranted: absence on this row does not establish zero contractual PIK. Proposed exact-cell/member comparison can detect recurrence as a flag; it must not auto-clear PIK or infer distress. The selected issuer-name detector does not assess this separate rate conflict. Detector is only proposed; implementation and false-positive testing remain future work.

Original Clearwater interest-rate cell is empty on 10,638/(27)/(27); the funded 57,447 row above prints 8.15. Exact-context facts contain spread 0.045 and maturity but no InvestmentInterestRate. The typed member supplies 8.15 and sandbox publishes it. This supports source ambiguity, not a zero-coupon claim. Proposed blank-cell plus absent numeric-fact check would flag inferred values without automatically deleting contractual terms; distinct sibling rows must remain separate. The selected issuer-name detector does not assess this separate rate conflict. Detector is only proposed; implementation and false-positive testing remain future work.
